title: Equipment and a designated compounding area for simple and moderate non-sterile compounding
subtopic: Simple and moderate non-sterile compounding equipment and area
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.19(1)(g) and (j), a pharmacy shall maintain on the pharmacy premises the equipment necessary to perform simple and moderate non-sterile compounding and a designated compounding area for simple and moderate non-sterile compounding. Under 247 CMR 9.19(23), the requirement of 247 CMR 9.19(1)(j), among others, does not apply to non-resident pharmacies, and under 247 CMR 9.19(24) the requirements of 247 CMR 9.19(1)(g) and (1)(j), among others, do not apply to institutional sterile compounding pharmacies.
exam_relevance: Tests that a pharmacy must maintain equipment and a designated area for simple and moderate non-sterile compounding, and which pharmacies 247 CMR 9.19 excepts.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: 247 CMR 9.19(23): the requirement of 247 CMR 9.19(1)(j) does not apply to non-resident pharmacies.
247 CMR 9.19(24): the requirements of 247 CMR 9.19(1)(g) and (1)(j) do not apply to institutional sterile compounding pharmacies.
common_confusions: The equipment and the designated area are to be maintained on the pharmacy premises; the provision is not conditioned on how often the pharmacy compounds.
The non-resident exception in 247 CMR 9.19(23) names the designated compounding area in 9.19(1)(j), not the equipment in 9.19(1)(g).
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024), including 247 CMR 9.19(23) and (24).
